//: A house that loses its last world (docs/GOALS.md, "A fallen house"): said plainly, the year after, with the ways back the game already has. FallenHouse raises the flag at the year's end and marks it as news.

effects.text: {self.name} swore before the household that the house would hold land again, and the household believed it.
The house lost its last world and said nothing of it. Its head went back to work the next morning.
{self.name} told the household that a house is its people and not its worlds. Some of the Reach said so too, and more said otherwise.
